notes:
The two independent passes agree on every requirement, id, cell and disposition; no disagreement was found.
Verifier 8 returns the group's type rather than a count; it duplicates the type cell of the group requirement and is carried there jointly with Verifier 1.
Group type Service Desk comes only from the benchmark; neither the request nor the policy names a type.
The benchmark's assignment-rule check also accepts the Health Coaching skill id appearing anywhere in based_on_skills; the requirement matches the skill by name, the storage format the seed's existing rules use.
The rule's priority cell is not tested by the benchmark: the request says medium, the policy lists medium yet names moderate as its case default, the seed's vocabulary is moderate, and both spellings pass.
Group, member, skill, user skill, topic detail, service and rule ids are each the next in their table's sequence because the task creates exactly one row in each.
